Overview

Selfoss is a city in South with a population of 9,000. South Iceland’s largest town and a growing service center near the Golden Circle’s natural wonders. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 130 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
